rationale: The papers 'Testing Physical and Phenomenological Models to Explain the Origin of the Soft E', 'Model of a `Warm Corona' as the Origin of the Soft X-ray Excess of Active Galactic Nuclei', 'A UV to X-ray view of soft excess in type 1 AGNs: I. sample selection and spectral profile', and 'A UV to X-Ray View of Soft Excess in Type 1 Active Galactic Nuclei. II. Broadband Correlations' contribute substantive new evidence on the nature of the soft X-ray excess in type 1 AGNs, exploring models and correlations, but do not fully settle the question.
